## Page, ink and font census (check.py --out handbook/tiles-chd32/<stem>)
- 21 of 21 PDFs returned `ok`. - Page size 209.9 x 297.0 mm on every sheet (A4). - Two colours per page (pure black and white). - Fonts: LiberationSerif (Iowan/Georgia fallback on this host), LiberationSerif-Bold/Italic, RoutedGothic, RoutedGothicNarrow, LiberationSans on sheets whose SVG carries a sans label. - 300 dpi tiles exist for all 21 stems under `handbook/tiles-chd32/` (8 band tiles + an overview per sheet).

## Body extent (pymupdf text blocks, footer band starts at 272.5 mm)
Maximum body extent across all 21 pages: **271.22 mm** (sheet 4.3), against the 275 mm limit. No page collides with the footer rule; footer top sits at 278.9 mm everywhere.

## Arrow property (R31-014): no store wakes a gateway, no agent writes a store
The only figure in Part I that draws a store actor is FIGURE 1.3-1 (DuckBrain, hatched box at x 124-170, y 38-54 of the viewBox). Its eight drawn edges are:
1. (90,10.4) -> (90,17.6) VP surface to director harness 2. (116.4,24.5) -> (123.6,24.5) director harness to gateway pool 3. (92,31.4) -> (92,39.6) director harness to ticket and control service 4. (116.4,46) -> (123.6,46) ticket service to DuckBrain 5. (44.4,43.4) -> (67.6,43.4) Crier to ticket service, inbound 6. (67.6,48.6) -> (44.4,48.6) ticket service to Crier, outbound acknowledgement 7. (169.6,24.5) -> (174.4,79) -> (169.6,79) gateway pool to foreman session: the wake 8. (123.6,79) -> (116.4,79) foreman report to work artefacts
No edge starts inside the store box, so there is no store-to-gateway wake arrow. No figure in Part I draws an agent with an edge into DuckBrain: agents reach control state only through controller-routed tools, and every such mention is prose (sheets 1.2, 1.4, 2.9).

## Id discipline
- Part I claims 50 ids (14 figures, 36 tables); no id appears on two Part I sheets. - Every id in `BOOK-chd32.yaml` sections 1-4 appears on a rendered sheet of that section. - Duplicate claims found elsewhere in the CHD-3.2 set, outside this ticket's ownership: TABLE 15.1-1 (15-1 and 15-2), TABLE 16.2-1 and TABLE 16.3-1 (16-2/16-3 and 16-4).

## Continuation and identity
- Every sheet carries `CHD-3.2` in the head and `CHD-3.2 . SECTION n . SHEET i OF k` in the footer, with the continuous leaf number and the date. - Sheets 2..k of each section carry a `SECTION n (CONTINUED)` opener. - Section 1's first sheet, and the first sheet of sections 2, 3 and 4, carry a boxed REVISION NOTICE naming the change from CHD-3.1. - No table is split across sheets in Part I, so no `units x-y of n` placard is required; the terminology table on 1.2 keeps its `units 1-20 of 20` placard.

## Placeholders
Zero `TBD`, `TODO`, `lorem`, `[BRACKETED]` or empty figure frames across the 21 sheets.
